title: Esc and P (Menu/Back) do not close most Town overlays: Journal, Map, Today (dailies), Achievements, Home plot, Polyroll
steps: Press L (Journal), or M (Map), or open Today / Achievements from the people panel, or press E at the Home plot or the Polyroll booth
expected: Esc / P close the top overlay (CONTROLS.md: Esc / P = Menu / Back; closeTopOverlay() already knows every overlay)
actual: The overlay stays open (flag still true, display:flex) after Esc and after P. Only Museum, Postcards and Able Sisters close on Esc (they have their own listeners). Player must click the small X.
suspect: game/main.js:2322 closeTopOverlay() is only called from the gamepad poll (main.js:2312-2314) and the nav sheet; there is no keyboard Escape/P listener that calls it (only postcards main.js:3108, museum main.js:4474, chat input main.js:9085)

title: Opening the people panel's 'More' tab paints a solid black (run 1) or white (run 2) rectangle over the bottom half of the screen under the panel
steps: Tap the '☰ More' tab inside the panel
expected: Only the panel draws; the town stays visible below it
actual: A 175x320 px opaque box (x 205-380, y 510-830) covers the canvas under the panel, hiding part of the town and sitting behind the Emotes/More/A/C buttons. elementFromPoint there returns the canvas / #chat-panel (transparent), so it may be the same headless-compositor artefact as the open 'Headless-only white box' item in bugbash/town.md, but this trigger (More tab, no What's-new banner) is new. Seen in 2/2 runs. Recheck on a real phone.
suspect: game/style.css people panel / feedback box (mmfb) overflow under #town-panel; or compositor (see bugbash/town.md Open)

title: Arcade doors named 'GTA 3', 'NFS Underground 2', 'Vice City' send players to third-party sites
steps: Play offline, open Where to? or walk to the Arcade District (x 1830-1970, y 870-960)
expected: Original content only (AGENTS.md: original art only); no trademarked game names; no one-way exits to unknown external hosts
actual: Doors labelled with trademarked titles link off-site to quenq.com, nfsu2.xyz and olivers.tools in the same tab (one-way, no way back). Brand/IP and safety risk for a public game; a player who walks into one loses the Town tab.
